records.titleEn: Employer fined for violation of safety legislation
records.titleZh: 僱主因違反安全法例被判罰款
records.summaryEn: Urban Property Management Limited (富城物業管理有限公司) was fined $30,000 at the Eastern Magistrates' Courts on 11 November 2026. The Labour Department launched the prosecution. The case involved a fatal accident on 3 July 2024 at a residential building in Wan Chai. A worker, while inspecting the lighting facilities inside the toilet of a residential unit, was suspected to have fallen from a metal ladder, sustained serious head injuries, and died two days later.
records.summaryZh: 富城物業管理有限公司因違反《職業安全及健康條例》的規定，被勞工處檢控，今日（十一月十一日）在東區裁判法院被判罰款三萬元。 案情涉及一宗於二○二四年七月三日在灣仔一幢住宅大廈發生的致命意外。一名工人在檢查一個住宅單位廁所內的照明設施時，懷疑從一把金屬梯具上墮下。該名工人頭部嚴重受傷，並於兩日後離世。
records.legalEn: Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (《職業安全及健康條例》). No chapter or section number was stated in the press release.

records.summaryEn: Cin Fung Engineering Limited (展鋒工程有限公司), a contractor (一名承建商; not named in the press release), and Kwan Wai Machinery Engineering Limited (鈞威機械工程有限公司) were fined $155,000, $155,000 and $130,000 respectively at the Fanling Magistrates' Courts on 10 November 2026. The Labour Department launched the prosecutions. The case involved a fatal accident on 5 November 2025 at a village house under demolition in Yuen Long. While a female worker was conducting manual clearing work outside the brick perimeter wall of the village house, the wall suddenly collapsed and pressed against her. She was certified dead in hospital the same day.
records.summaryZh: 展鋒工程有限公司、一名承建商及鈞威機械工程有限公司因違反《工廠及工業經營條例》的規定被勞工處檢控，今日（十一月十日）在粉嶺裁判法院分別被判罰款十五萬五千元、十五萬五千元及十三萬元。 案情涉及一宗於二○二五年十一月五日在元朗一棟拆卸中的村屋發生的致命意外。一名女工於拆卸中的村屋的磚砌圍牆外進行人手清理工作時，該圍牆突然倒塌並將其壓住，同日送院後證實不治。

records.titleEn: Labour Department highly concerned about fatal work accident that happened in Sha Tin today
records.titleZh: 勞工處高度關注今日在沙田發生的致命工作意外
records.summaryEn: On the morning of 5 November 2026, on a construction site in Sha Tin, a female worker was run over by a grab lorry and died while washing vehicle tyres on the vehicular lane at a site entrance. The Labour Department stated that it had deployed staff to the scene, was investigating, and had issued suspension notices to the contractors concerned, suspending any work on the vehicular lane at the site until the Department was satisfied that suitable measures to abate the relevant risks had been taken. The same-day “investigates” release stated that a woman had died. The “highly concerned” release said a Work Safety Alert would be issued; as of this scan, no November 2026 alert was listed on the official 2026 Work Safety Alert index.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處高度關注今日（十一月五日）上午在沙田一個建築地盤內發生的致命工作意外。意外中，一名女工在地盤出入口行車路進行沖洗車輛輪胎工作時，被一輛抓斗貨車輾斃。 勞工處發言人說：「在得知意外發生後，本處已即時派員到意外現場展開調查。我們已向有關承建商發出『暫時停工通知書』，停止其在該地盤的行車路上進行任何工作，直至我們信納有關承建商已採取適當的措施消除有關危害，才可復工。」 就今日的意外，勞工處會於日內透過其「職安健2.0」流動應用程式、網頁及電子郵件發放「職安警示」。
records.legalEn: The press release cited the general duty provisions of the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (《職業安全及健康條例》的一般責任條款). No section number was stated.
records.legalZh: 《職業安全及健康條例》；一般責任條款。官方中文來源未列明條次。

records.titleEn: LD further enhances Heat Stress at Work Warning system
records.titleZh: 勞工處進一步優化「工作暑熱警告」系統
records.summaryEn: On 27 August 2026 the Labour Department announced that, with effect from 28 August 2026, the Heat Stress at Work Warning (「工作暑熱警告」) system would be further enhanced. The release stated two new triggering conditions: when the Hong Kong Observatory’s “Extremely Hot Weather” Special Alert is in effect, the monitoring threshold for triggering a higher warning level would be lowered; and when measured temperatures generally over Hong Kong reach 35 degrees Celsius or above, the monitoring threshold would be lowered and the warning level would be raised automatically by one level (Amber to Red, or Red to Black). The release also stated that from April 2026 the Department had added heat-index readings from nine locations besides King’s Park as issuing criteria, and referred to the Guidance Notes on Prevention of Heat Stroke at Work (《預防工作時中暑指引》). The release did not announce a new ordinance or regulation.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處今日（八月二十七日）宣布，將於明日（八月二十八日）起進一步優化「工作暑熱警告」系統。經優化的系統將加入兩個觸發不同級別「工作暑熱警告」的新條件：第一，當香港天文台發出的「極端酷熱天氣」特別提示生效期間，觸發更高級別警告的監測門檻將會降低，以及早啓動更高級別警告；第二，若全港多處地區實測氣溫達攝氏35度或以上，除觸發警告的監測門檻降低外，警告級別亦會自動上調一級（即黃色警告轉為紅色，或紅色警告轉為黑色）。公報並稱，今年四月起，除沿用京士柏監測站量度的「香港暑熱指數」數據外，勞工處已加入其他九個地點的數據作為發出「工作暑熱警告」的準則。公報提及《預防工作時中暑指引》，並未宣布訂立或修訂條例或規例。

records.titleEn: Addenda to Code of Practice for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety and Code of Practice for Metal Scaffolding Safety gazetted
records.titleZh: 《竹棚架工作安全守則》及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》增編刊憲
records.summaryEn: On 31 July 2026 the Labour Department published in the Gazette addenda to the Code of Practice for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety (《竹棚架工作安全守則》) and the Code of Practice for Metal Scaffolding Safety (《金屬棚架工作安全守則》), to take immediate effect. The official Codes of Practice pages name the instruments as Addendum No. 1/2026 (第 1/2026 號增編), effective on 31 July 2026. The press release stated that the major revisions were: material requirements for scaffolding toe-boards so that their strength is sufficient to prevent workers and objects from falling and that the materials used do not increase the fire risk; a requirement that protective screens (including protective nets, tarpaulins, plastic sheeting and canvas) fulfil the requirements in the Buildings Department’s Practice Note for Registered Contractors 85 (《註冊承建商作業備考85》) on fire-retardant performance; and a requirement that the design and installation of catch-fans fulfil the Buildings Department’s Guidelines on the Design and Construction of Bamboo Scaffolds (《竹棚架設計及搭建指引》).
records.summaryZh: 勞工處今日（七月三十一日）在憲報刊登《竹棚架工作安全守則》（《竹棚架守則》）及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》（《金屬棚架守則》）增編，即日生效。勞工處「乙部：工作守則」中文網頁將該等文件稱為第1/2026號增編，並註明在2026年7月31日起生效。官方公報述主要修訂內容包括：（i）訂定棚架底護板物料的要求，確保其強度足夠防止棚架上工人和物件墮下，且所用的物料不得增加火警風險；（ii）安裝在棚架上的保護幕（包括保護網、防水油布、塑膠布及帆布）應符合屋宇署發出的《註冊承建商作業備考85》所訂明的要求，以確保保護幕符合規定的阻燃效能標準；以及（iii）要求斜柵的設計及安裝應符合屋宇署發出的《竹棚架設計及搭建指引》的相關規定。公報並稱，這些守則具有特殊的法律地位；在刑事訴訟中，若相關人士不遵從這些守則所載的任何條文，法庭可接納這種行徑為有關因素，用以裁定某人是否觸犯有關的職安健法例。
records.legalEn: The press release stated that the codes provide practical guidance on complying with occupational safety and health legislation regarding scaffolding work, and that in criminal proceedings a failure to observe any provision of the codes may be taken by the court as a relevant factor in determining whether a person has breached the relevant safety and health legislation. No ordinance chapter or section was cited as being amended.

records.titleEn: Legislation on comprehensive smoking ban on construction sites takes effect today
records.titleZh: 建築地盤全面禁煙法例今日生效
records.summaryEn: The Labour Department and the Government press release stated that three legislative amendments took effect on 17 July 2026: the Construction Sites (Safety) (Amendment) Regulation 2026 (《2026年建築地盤（安全）（修訂）規例》), which took effect upon gazettal that day; and the Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 2) Order 2026 (《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》) and the Fixed Penalty (Smoking Offences) (Specification of Authorities and Public Officers) (Amendment) Notice 2026 (《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》), which had been published in the Gazette on 22 May 2026 and also took effect on 17 July 2026. The Labour Department’s Chinese page stated that the Legislative Council passed the three amendments on 15 July 2026. The official pages stated that all types of construction sites, including those for building repair, maintenance or renovation, are designated as no smoking areas, except domestic premises or private quarters occupied by residents for residential purposes; that Occupational Safety Officers may issue a fixed penalty notice of $3,000 without prior warning for a smoking act on a construction site; and that contractors and subcontractors shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that no person uses a naked light for lighting, or smokes or carries a lighted smoking product, on a construction site, with a maximum fine of $400,000 on conviction.
records.summaryZh: 《2026年建築地盤（安全）（修訂）規例》今日（七月十七日）刊憲並生效。此外，於二○二六年五月二十二日在憲報刊登的《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》及《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》亦於今日生效。勞工處中文專頁並述，立法會於2026年7月15日通過上述三項法例修訂。所有類型的建築地盤，包括樓宇修葺、維修或翻新工程等地盤，俱已指定為禁止吸煙區。住客正佔用的住宅或私人宿舍作居住用途的範圍則不包括在內。勞工處職業安全主任已獲賦權負責執行所有涉及在建築地盤內吸煙罪行的執法工作。任何人士在建築地盤內作出吸煙行為，職安主任會即時票控而不予事先警告。違例者將被處定額罰款三千元。建築地盤的承建商及分判商須採取所有合理步驟，以確保沒有人在建築地盤內使用明火點燃、吸用或攜帶燃着的吸煙產品。違例者經法院判定最高可處罰款40萬元。
records.legalEn: Construction Sites (Safety) Regulation (Cap. 59I) (《建築地盤（安全）規例》（第59I章）), including regulation 53 as cited on the Labour Department page; Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance (Cap. 371) (《吸煙（公眾衞生）條例》（第371章）); Fixed Penalty (Smoking Offences) Ordinance (Cap. 600) (《定額罰款（吸煙罪行）條例》（第600章）). The Labour Department commencement page pointed to the Government Gazette (https://egazette.gld.gov.hk/en) and Hong Kong e-Legislation (https://www.elegislation.gov.hk) for the instrument texts; those statute and Gazette viewers could not be read during this backfill.
records.legalZh: 《2026年建築地盤（安全）（修訂）規例》；《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》；《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》。勞工處中文專頁並提述《建築地盤（安全）規例》（第59I章）第53條（現有刊物內容以《地盤修例》為準）、《吸煙（公眾衞生）條例》及《定額罰款（吸煙罪行）條例》（第600章）。該專頁指出法例原文見電子憲報及電子版香港法例；此次未再讀取該等可能受阻的法規文本。
records.sourceNote: 官方公報標題為「建築地盤全面禁煙法例今日生效（附圖／短片）」，登記冊中文標題略去「（附圖／短片）」。 勞工處另有中文「建築地盤實施全面禁煙的安全提示」專頁，屬安全提示，並非職安警示。摘要只取該頁及生效公告中與登記冊摘要對應的事實，不包括有關「合理步驟」的指導清單。

records.titleEn: Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 2) Order 2026 and Fixed Penalty (Smoking Offences) (Specification of Authorities and Public Officers) (Amendment) Notice 2026 published in the Gazette
records.titleZh: 《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》及《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》刊憲
records.summaryEn: On 19 May 2026 the Labour Department announced that two pieces of subsidiary legislation would be published in the Gazette on 22 May 2026: the Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 2) Order 2026 (《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》) and the Fixed Penalty (Smoking Offences) (Specification of Authorities and Public Officers) (Amendment) Notice 2026 (《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》). The 17 July 2026 official commencement pages later confirmed that those two instruments were published in the Gazette on 22 May 2026 and took effect on 17 July 2026, together with the Construction Sites (Safety) (Amendment) Regulation 2026 (《2026年建築地盤（安全）（修訂）規例》). The official announcement of 19 May also described the intended no-smoking designation of construction sites, a $3,000 fixed penalty, and a maximum fine of $400,000 for contractors and subcontractors. The Gazette texts themselves could not be read during this backfill.
records.summaryZh: 政府今日（五月十九日）向立法會提交三項法例修訂，包括《2026年吸煙（公眾衞生）條例（修訂附表2）令》（《修訂令》）、《2026年定額罰款（吸煙罪行）（指明主管當局及公職人員）（修訂）公告》（《修訂公告》）及《2026年建築地盤（安全）（修訂）規例》（《地盤修例》）。政府將於五月二十二日在憲報刊登《修訂令》及《修訂公告》，在《修訂令》指定建築地盤為禁止吸煙區，並在《修訂公告》指明勞工處職業安全主任可依據《定額罰款（吸煙罪行）條例》（第600章）執行所有涉及在建築地盤吸煙罪行的執法工作。任何人在建築地盤吸煙即屬違法，職安主任可依據該條例向違例者發出定額罰款通知書，定額罰款三千元。《修訂令》適用於所有類型建築地盤，包括大廈維修工程地盤，而住客正佔用的住宅及私人宿舍作居住用途的範圍則不包括在內。同時，《地盤修例》要求承建商及分判商須採取所有合理步驟，以確保在建築地盤內無人吸用或攜帶燃着的指明吸煙產品，或使用無遮蓋燈火點燃指明吸煙產品，否則會觸犯《地盤修例》規定，最高可處罰款40萬元。其後勞工處中文專頁確認：《修訂令》及《修訂公告》於2026年5月22日在憲報刊登，並與於2026年7月17日刊憲並生效的《地盤修例》同於該日生效。憲報文本本身在登記冊回填時未能讀取；此次亦未再讀取電子憲報或電子版香港法例文本。
records.legalEn: Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance (Cap. 371) (《吸煙（公眾衞生）條例》（第371章）); Fixed Penalty (Smoking Offences) Ordinance (Cap. 600) (《定額罰款（吸煙罪行）條例》（第600章）). No Gazette legal-notice number (L.N.) was stated on the official pages that were read.

records.titleEn: Dragages Hong Kong Limited fined $154,800 for fatal industrial accident
records.titleZh: 香港寶嘉建築有限公司因致命工業意外被判罰款十五萬四千八百元
records.summaryEn: On 18 May 2026 at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts, Dragages Hong Kong Limited (香港寶嘉建築有限公司) was fined $154,800 after being prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaches of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance, the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Lifting Appliances and Lifting Gear) Regulations, the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations, and the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation. The case concerned a fatal accident on 10 November 2023 at a construction site in Tung Chung, Lantau, in which a metal fin fell during a lifting operation for facade installation and struck an employee walking underneath the lifting area. The employee was seriously injured and passed away on the same day.
records.summaryZh: 香港寶嘉建築有限公司因違反《工廠及工業經營條例》、《工廠及工業經營（起重機械及起重裝置）規例》、《建築地盤（安全）規例》及《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》的規定被勞工處檢控，今日（五月十八日）在觀塘裁判法院被判罰款十五萬四千八百元。 案情涉及一宗於二○二三年十一月十日在大嶼山東涌一個建築地盤發生的致命意外。當吊運一塊金屬片以進行外牆安裝時，金屬片墮下並擊中一名行經吊運工作位置下方的僱員，該名僱員嚴重受傷，並於同日離世。
records.legalEn: Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance (《工廠及工業經營條例》); Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Lifting Appliances and Lifting Gear) Regulations (《工廠及工業經營（起重機械及起重裝置）規例》); Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations (《建築地盤（安全）規例》); Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation (《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》). No chapter or section numbers were stated in the press release.

records.titleEn: Labour Department launches revised “Guidance Notes on Safe Use of Mobile Elevating Work Platforms”
records.titleZh: 勞工處推出《安全使用移動式升降工作平台指引》修訂版
records.summaryEn: On 4 February 2026 the Labour Department launched the revised Guidance Notes on Safe Use of Mobile Elevating Work Platforms (《安全使用移動式升降工作平台指引》). The official pages state that the document was revised and renamed from the Guidance Notes on Safe Use of Power-operated Elevating Work Platforms (《安全使用動力操作升降工作台指引》). The press release stated that the revisions included risk control measures such as regular non-destructive tests for critical load-bearing components of MEWPs and the formulation of emergency rescue plans; recommendations on the application of secondary guarding devices; and a recommendation that operators of boom-type and scissor-type MEWPs receive recognised training and obtain relevant certificates. A grace period for the training recommendation and the application of secondary guarding devices was stated to last until 31 December 2026, with those recommendations taking effect on 1 January 2027.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處今日（二月四日）推出經修訂的《安全使用移動式升降工作平台指引》（《指引》）。勞工處中文專頁及公報述，處方修訂原有的《安全使用動力操作升降工作台指引》，並重新命名。主要修訂包括進一步訂明操作員的訓練要求（中文專頁說明：訓練要理論及實習兼備，完成訓練後，操作員需通過適當的考核，才可成為合資格的操作員）、操作上的新增要求（如安裝有效的輔助防護裝置、對關鍵承重部件進行定期無損檢測），以及制定緊急情況的救援計劃。操作員的訓練及安裝輔助防護裝置的新要求設有寬限期至今年十二月三十一日；中文專頁並註明即在二零二七年一月一日起實施。

records.titleEn: Hip Seng Construction Company Limited fined $210,000 for fatal industrial accident
records.titleZh: 協盛建築有限公司因致命工業意外被判罰款二十一萬元
records.summaryEn: On 22 December 2025 at Shatin Magistrates’ Courts, Hip Seng Construction Company Limited (協盛建築有限公司) was fined $210,000 after being prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaches of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance, the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations, and the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation. The case concerned a fatal accident on 9 November 2024 at a construction site in Sha Tin, in which a worker loading boxes of tiles onto the platform of a material hoist on an upper floor of a building under construction was trapped between the hoist cage and the landing when the platform suddenly descended, and was certified dead on the same day.
records.summaryZh: 協盛建築有限公司因違反《工廠及工業經營條例》、《建築地盤（安全）規例》及《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》的規定被勞工處檢控，今日（十二月二十二日）在沙田裁判法院被判罰款二十一萬元。 案情涉及一宗於二○二四年十一月九日在沙田一個建築地盤發生的致命意外。一名工人在一幢建築中樓宇的上層將一箱箱的瓷磚搬運到一部物料吊重機的載貨平台時，物料吊重機平台突然下降引致該工人被夾在物料吊重機的機籠及該上層樓層平台之間，他於同日證實死亡。
records.legalEn: Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance (《工廠及工業經營條例》); Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations (《建築地盤（安全）規例》); Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation (《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》). No chapter or section numbers were stated in the press release.

records.titleZh: 法院頒布覆核裁決並提高健豐木行有限公司因致命工業意外的罰款
records.summaryEn: On 19 December 2025 at Fanling Magistrates’ Courts, the court delivered a review decision and allowed the prosecution’s application to review an earlier sentence, increasing the fine on Kinform Timber Company Limited (健豐木行有限公司). The company, being the employer of a fork-lift truck operator, had been prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaching the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance and had been fined $120,000 on 21 January 2025 at the same court. The fine was increased to $160,000. The case concerned a fatal accident on 14 March 2024 at a warehouse in Sandy Ridge, New Territories, in which a bundle of wooden battens fell from a trailer during fork-lift unloading and struck another worker, who was injured and passed away on the same day.
records.summaryZh: 就一宗致命工業意外的判刑，粉嶺裁判法院今日（十二月十九日）頒布覆核裁決，接受控方就較早前法院判刑的覆核申請，並提高僱主的罰款。 案情涉及一宗於二○二四年三月十四日在新界沙嶺一個倉庫發生的致命意外。當一名工人使用叉式起重車從貨車拖架卸下木方時，一捆木方從拖架跌下並擊中另一名工人，該工人受傷並於同日離世。 健豐木行有限公司作為該叉式起重車操作員的僱主，因違反《職業安全及健康條例》的規定，被勞工處檢控，於二○二五年一月二十一日在粉嶺裁判法院被判罰款十二萬元。 判刑後，控方就有關僱主的刑罰向法庭提出覆核申請。覆核聆訊今日在粉嶺裁判法院進行。健豐木行有限公司的罰款被提高至十六萬元。

records.titleEn: Labour Department launches Guidance Notes on Prevention of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning in Workplaces
records.titleZh: 勞工處推出《預防工作場所一氧化碳中毒指引》
records.summaryEn: On 17 December 2025 the Labour Department launched the Guidance Notes on Prevention of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning in Workplaces (《預防工作場所一氧化碳中毒指引》) to provide practical information for employers, employees and relevant duty holders on preventing carbon monoxide poisoning in workplaces. The press release stated that the notes cover the sources and hazards of carbon monoxide in workplaces, preventive measures, and a safe system of work including risk assessment, monitoring and measurement of carbon monoxide, emergency procedures and training. The Department said it would jointly organise an online seminar with the Occupational Safety and Health Council in January 2026 to introduce the guidance notes to stakeholders in the construction, catering, property management, logistics and freight, and cleansing and environmental hygiene industries.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處今日（十二月十七日）推出《預防工作場所一氧化碳中毒指引》，為僱主、僱員及相關持責者提供實用資訊，預防工人在工作場所出現一氧化碳中毒的情況。公報述指引內容涵蓋在工作場所一氧化碳的來源及危害、預防措施，以及安全工作系統包括風險評估、一氧化碳的監測與測量、緊急處理程序及培訓等。勞工處將聯同職業安全健康局於二○二六年一月舉辦網上講座，向建造、飲食、物業管理、物流貨運、潔淨及環境衞生等相關行業的持份者介紹該指引。

records.summaryEn: On 9 December 2025 at Fanling Magistrates’ Courts, Ben's Tak China H.K. Machinery Transportation Limited (賓仕德中港重型機械搬運有限公司) was fined $170,000 and a proprietor (一名東主) was fined $130,000 after being prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaches of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance and the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Lifting Appliances and Lifting Gear) Regulations. The case concerned a fatal accident on 23 December 2024 at an open storage yard in Sheung Shui, in which a worker standing beside a lorry-mounted crane was struck by metal pipes that suddenly rolled off the deck of the crane after the tightening straps securing the pipes were unfastened, and was certified dead on the same day.

records.titleEn: Court makes review decision and increases fine on a contractor for fatal industrial accident
records.titleZh: 法院頒布覆核裁決並提高承建商因致命工業意外的罰款
records.summaryEn: On 8 December 2025 at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts, the court delivered a review decision and allowed the prosecution’s application to review an earlier sentence on a contractor (一名承建商), who was not named in the official press release. The contractor had been prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaching the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations and had been fined $90,000 on 8 November 2024 at the same court, with payment allowed in 90 instalments of $1,000 per month. The fine was increased to $160,000 and, after deducting $12,000 already paid, was to be paid in 74 instalments of $2,000 per month. The case concerned a fatal accident on 7 May 2022 at a residential unit under renovation in Jordan, in which a scaffolder fell to the ground and died while preparing to erect a truss-out bamboo scaffold on an external wall.
records.summaryZh: 就一宗致命工業意外的判刑，觀塘裁判法院今日（十二月八日）頒布覆核裁決，接受控方就較早前法院判刑的覆核申請，提高承建商的罰款，並以一個期數較少而金額較高的方式分期繳付罰款。 案情涉及二○二二年五月七日佐敦一個住宅單位維修工程中發生的致命意外，一名搭棚工人在該單位外牆預備搭建懸空式棚架時，墮下至地面身亡。 一名承建商因違反《建築地盤（安全）規例》被勞工處檢控，於二○二四年十一月八日在觀塘裁判法院被判罰款九萬元，並獲准以每月一千元、分90期的方式繳付罰款。 判刑後，控方就有關承建商的刑罰向法庭提出覆核申請。覆核聆訊今日在觀塘裁判法院進行。該名承建商的罰款被提高至十六萬元，以及扣除已經繳交的罰款一萬二千元後，以每月二千元、分74期的方式繳付罰款。

records.titleEn: Chiu Hing Construction & Transportation Company Limited, Dixie Engineering Company Limited and Wah Fung Building & Engineering Limited fined for fatal industrial accident
records.titleZh: 昭興建築運輸有限公司、仁利工程有限公司及華丰建設工程有限公司因致命工業意外被判罰款
records.summaryEn: On 5 December 2025 at Shatin Magistrates’ Courts, Chiu Hing Construction & Transportation Company Limited (昭興建築運輸有限公司) was fined $256,000, Dixie Engineering Company Limited (仁利工程有限公司) was fined $216,000, and Wah Fung Building & Engineering Limited (華丰建設工程有限公司) was fined $217,000 after being prosecuted by the Labour Department for breaches of the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance, the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations, and the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation. The official Chinese name of the third company uses the character 丰. The case concerned a fatal accident on 22 April 2024 at a sewer-pipe clearing work site in Sha Tin, in which two workers lost consciousness and died inside a manhole while conducting clearing work, and two more workers were injured when they tried to rescue the two deceased workers.

records.summaryEn: On the afternoon of 1 December 2025, at a construction site in Tuen Mun, a male worker was suspected to have been struck by a hard object ejected from a moving excavator. records.titleZh: 一名承建商因致命工業意外被判罰款二十二萬元

records.titleEn: Labour Department highly concerned about No. 5 alarm fire at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po
records.titleZh: 勞工處高度關注大埔宏福苑五級火警
records.summaryEn: On 27 November 2025 the Labour Department stated that it was highly concerned about the No. 5 alarm fire at Wang Fuk Court (宏福苑), Tai Po, on 26 November 2025, and that the fire had caused multiple casualties. The Department announced a two-week territory-wide special enforcement operation from 28 November 2025, targeting fire protection facilities and fire emergency preparedness at building-maintenance work sites with large-scale scaffolding erected, including whether protective screens (scaffold nets) complied with recognised standards for fire-retardant materials, and said it would work with the Buildings Department to inspect buildings undergoing major external wall repairs with large-scale bamboo scaffolds. On 1 December 2025 the Department stated that, according to a preliminary investigation, five construction workers of a contractor (three men and two women) had passed away in the fire, and that it was conducting a joint investigation with other departments.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處發言人今日（十一月二十七日）表示，高度關注昨日大埔宏福苑五級火警，並稱火災導致多人傷亡。勞工處將於明日起展開為期兩周的全港性特別執法行動，巡查架設有大型棚架的樓宇維修工程地盤的防火設施及火災應變安排，當中包括檢查棚架上的保護幕（俗稱「棚網」）符合阻燃性的認可標準。同時，勞工處亦會配合屋宇署巡查正進行外牆大維修而有架設大型竹棚架的樓宇，確保設置棚架上的棚網符合相關工作守則／指引的要求。其後發言人於十二月一日表示，根據初步調查，至今有五名工程承建商工人（三男二女）在大埔五級火警中遇難；勞工處正聯同其他部門進行聯合調查。
records.legalEn: The 12 December 2025 press release cited the general duty provisions of the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (《職業安全及健康條例》的一般責任條款). No section number was stated. A later prosecution arising from this fire is recorded separately in the 90-day portion of this register (9 September 2026) and was not overwritten.
records.legalZh: 十二月十二日完成特別執法行動的中文公報援引《職業安全及健康條例》的一般責任條款。官方中文來源未列明條次。其後就同一火災提出的檢控另見本登記冊2026年9月9日紀錄，並未覆寫本筆。

updatesEn.value: 2025-12-12 (issued at 18:59 HKT): The Labour Department stated that it had completed the two-week special enforcement operation. From 28 November 2025 it had inspected 467 construction sites, issued 249 written warnings and 112 improvement notices, and initiated 25 prosecutions, which the Department said mainly involved the prohibition of smoking at sites, as well as failure to maintain fire escapes and fire-fighting appliances in good condition, unsafe working at height, and failure to provide personal protective equipment. The Department said it would continue to follow up on sites with detected violations and to inspect work sites where scaffold nets had been removed from external walls of buildings.

updatesZh.value: 勞工處發言人今日（十二月十二日）表示，處方今日完成為期兩周針對設有大型棚架的樓宇維修工地的特別執法行動。勞工處在十一月二十八日開展的特別執法行動中巡查了467個建築地盤，共發出249份書面警告及112張「敦促改善通知書」，並提出25宗檢控，主要涉及地盤內禁止吸煙、走火通道和滅火器沒有保持良好狀況、不安全的高處工作及沒有提供個人防護裝備等違規情況。公報並稱會繼續跟進違規地盤的改善情況，及繼續巡查已移除樓宇外牆棚網的工地。

records.titleEn: China Overseas Building Construction Limited, World Pacific Scaffolding Systems Limited and Kam Yep Engineering Company Limited fined for fatal industrial accident
records.titleZh: 中國海外房屋工程有限公司、滙寶棚業系統有限公司及錦恩工程有限公司因致命工業意外被判罰款
records.summaryEn: On 24 November 2025 at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts, China Overseas Building Construction Limited (中國海外房屋工程有限公司) was fined $170,000, World Pacific Scaffolding Systems Limited (滙寶棚業系統有限公司) was fined $150,000, and Kam Yep Engineering Company Limited (錦恩工程有限公司) was fined $190,000 after being prosecuted by the Labour Department. The official press release stated that China Overseas Building Construction Limited had violated the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations and the Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation, and that the other two companies had violated the Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations. The case concerned a fatal accident on 18 April 2021 at a construction site at the Kai Tak area, in which it was believed that a worker fell from height to the podium while conducting scaffolding work at a building under construction. The worker was sent to hospital and passed away on the same day.
records.summaryZh: 中國海外房屋工程有限公司、滙寶棚業系統有限公司及錦恩工程有限公司被勞工處檢控，今日（十一月二十四日）在九龍城裁判法院分別被判罰款十七萬元、十五萬元及十九萬元。 中國海外房屋工程有限公司違反《建築地盤（安全）規例》及《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》的規定，滙寶棚業系統有限公司及錦恩工程有限公司違反《建築地盤（安全）規例》的規定。 案情涉及一宗於二○二一年四月十八日在啟德地區一個建築地盤發生的致命意外。相信一名工人在一幢興建中的樓宇進行棚架工作時從高處墮下至平台。工人被送往醫院並於同日離世。
records.legalEn: Construction Sites (Safety) Regulations (《建築地盤（安全）規例》); Factories and Industrial Undertakings (Safety Management) Regulation (《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》). No chapter or section numbers were stated in the press release.
records.legalZh: 《建築地盤（安全）規例》、《工廠及工業經營（安全管理）規例》。官方中文來源未列明條次。
records.sourceNote: 登記冊中文標題為「中國海外房屋工程有限公司、滙寶棚業系統有限公司及錦恩工程有限公司因致命工業意外被判罰款」；已讀取的官方中文公報標題為「承建商因違反安全法例被判罰款」。

records.titleEn: Labour Department highly concerned about fatal work accident that happened in Sai Kung yesterday
records.titleZh: 勞工處高度關注昨日在西貢發生的致命工作意外
records.summaryEn: On the morning of 22 November 2025, a fatal work accident occurred which the official English press release described as happening “at a construction in Sai Kung.” The official Chinese press release stated that it occurred at a construction site in Sai Kung (西貢一建築地盤). A male worker operating a concrete core drilling machine had his clothing entangled by the cutting drill of the machine, causing his neck to be strangled by his clothing. He was certified dead later in hospital. The Labour Department stated that it had issued suspension notices to the contractors concerned, suspending the use of concrete core drilling machines for concrete coring work on the site until the Department was satisfied that suitable measures to abate the relevant risks had been taken.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處高度關注昨日（十一月二十二日）上午在西貢一建築地盤發生的致命工作意外。意外中一名男工在操作混凝土鑽孔機期間，穿在身上的衣物被鑽孔機的鑽頭纏繞，以致其頸部被衣物勒着，送院後證實不治。 勞工處發言人說：「在得知意外發生後，本處已即時派員到意外現場展開調查。我們已向有關承建商發出『暫時停工通知書』，停止其在其地盤內使用混凝土鑽孔機進行鑽孔工作，直至我們信納有關僱主已採取適當的措施消除有關危害，才可復工。」
records.legalEn: The press release cited the general duty provisions of the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance (《職業安全及健康條例》的一般責任條款). No section number was stated.
records.legalZh: 《職業安全及健康條例》；一般責任條款。官方中文來源未列明條次。
records.sourceNote: 英文公報表述為 “at a construction in Sai Kung”；官方中文公報述「西貢一建築地盤」。摘要從中文來源。

records.titleEn: Work Safety Alert — Entangled with revolving drill bit of concrete coring machine
records.titleZh: 職安警示 — 被一部混凝土鑽孔機的旋轉鑽頭纏繞
records.summaryEn: The official alert states the date of accident as November 2025 and the place as a construction site (一個建築地盤). While operating a pedestal-type concrete coring machine to drill a hole in a wall, a worker’s clothing became entangled with the revolving drill bit, resulting in strangulation. He was rushed to hospital and passed away later the same day. The source gives no calendar day or district. Because the official date is month-only, it is not possible from the alert alone to confirm that the accident occurred on or after 19 November 2025.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處官方職安警示列意外日期為2025年11月，意外地點為一個建築地盤。一名工人在操作一部立式混凝土鑽孔機在牆壁鑽孔時，其衣服被該鑽孔機的旋轉鑽頭纏繞而致頸部受壓。他被送往醫院後，於同日證實死亡。
records.legalEn: None stated on the summary pages of the alert that were read.

records.titleEn: Work Safety Alert — Pressed by Toppled Gypsum Boards
records.titleZh: 職安警示 — 被翻倒石膏板壓倒
records.summaryEn: The official alert states the date of accident as November 2025 and the place as an open-air car park (一個露天停車場). While handling a stack of gypsum boards stored vertically in a car park, a male worker was crushed when the boards suddenly toppled onto him. He was rushed to hospital and passed away later the same day. The source gives no calendar day or district. Because the official date is month-only, it is not possible from the alert alone to confirm that the accident occurred on or after 19 November 2025.
records.summaryZh: 勞工處官方職安警示列意外日期為2025年11月，意外地點為一個露天停車場。一名男工在一個停車場處理豎立存放的一疊石膏板時，石膏板突然翻倒壓住他，他被送往醫院後，於當日證實死亡。

records.titleZh: 職安警示 — 被倒塌的牆壁壓斃
records.summaryEn: The official alert states the date of accident as November 2025 and the place as a village house under demolition (一棟拆卸中的村屋). While a female worker was conducting manual clearing work outside the brick perimeter wall of a village house under demolition, the perimeter wall suddenly collapsed and crushed her. She was pronounced dead at the hospital on the same day. The source gives no calendar day or district. Because the official date is month-only, it is not possible from the alert alone to confirm that the accident occurred on or after 19 November 2025.

records.summaryEn: The official alert states the date of accident as November 2025 and the place as a building site (一個建築地盤). While distributing bamboo members on a bamboo scaffold erected on the external wall of a building under construction, a bamboo scaffolder fell a distance of 30 metres to the ground and was fatally injured. The source gives no calendar day or district. Because the official date is month-only, it is not possible from the alert alone to confirm that the accident occurred on or after 19 November 2025.
